title: lists every failed row with the issue its notes name, or says none is named
why: A failed row dropped from the page: the gate issue would read as clean while a step failed.

title: refuses a rehearsal by its artefacts
why: A rehearsal's run let through: practice would be written up as the candidate's gate.

title: never writes pass for a row the record marks not automated
why: A row no machine passed written as pass: the page would claim more than the record says.

title: refuses a build run that is not the tag's commit
why: A build of another commit accepted: the page would vouch for a build the tag is not.

title: refuses an acceptance run of another tag
why: An acceptance run of an earlier candidate written up as this one's.
